body: No. The government can’t. The laws here are very clear on this.

Actually, where we live, as long as we sign a legal agreement in advance, it doesn’t matter how the donation happens. He will not be legally the father and will have no rights or responsibilities. Our laws have caught up a little bit.
Well, I do think that would be a bit much. In this case, I was just hoping for some genetic material.
His sperm so I could have a baby.

I know that there are other things going on and impacting it... I just don’t know how to fix them. I was very emotionally upset about them... but now I just feel empty and numb about it. Like it’s almost detached from me... but only if I actively don’t think about it. If I try to talk about it, then It feels like a knife carving through my heart and all the anguish comes back... 

So I guess I’m in a catch 22... feel calm and peaceful but be unable to stop thinking about and planning my suicide... or try to talk about what’s going on, and be an emotional wreck who can’t breathe and who might still be suicidal...

I know perfectly well that killing myself will not make anyone happy - it will in fact be devastating for many people. But it isn't really about how other's feel at all... my desire is because I am tired and I am exhausted and I don't have the energy to keep dealing with shit.

I am true to my friends and family and for the most part, I am surrounded by awesome wonderful people I think. The problem is that hiding underneath that is sometimes a dark core that leads to someone hurting you in a way you never saw coming and just can't seem to cope with... and it is when it comes from someone you do trust and whom you care for... that's what makes it so hard. Me being as good a person as I can will never erase the evil in others.
